title: Wang-Qiu-Hu switching and isomorphism
summary: Cospectral graphs (graphs that share the same eigenvalues) expose the limitations of using the graph spectrum to uniquely identify graphs, and they also help to understand what structural properties a graph spectrum cannot capture. Switching methods, which are standard tools for constructing cospectral graphs, require specific structural and algebraic conditions to hold for the operation to preserve the graph's spectrum.
